# dependencytrack_extension_config (Resource)

Config of an extension, such as the Trivy analyzer. Dependency-Track v5 only. Every extension always has a config, so creating this resource replaces it and destroying it leaves the server config as it is.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `config` (String) Config as a JSON object. It replaces the whole config, so fields left out lose their server defaults. Dependency-Track validates it against the extension's config schema, and secret fields take the name of a `dependencytrack_secret`.
- `extension` (String) Extension, e.g. `trivy` or `github`
- `extension_point` (String) Extension point, e.g. `vuln-analyzer` or `vuln-data-source`

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Synthetic ID in the form of extension_point/extension
